grammar.summary: 本课讲述「自己动手」的风气与作者修理割草机的经历，开篇即用 so...that 引导的倒装句强调热情之高，文中大量运用分词短语作状语描述动作过程，并通过 used to / would 表达过去的习惯与意愿。

points.title: so...that 倒装句 (Inverted Result Clause)
points.explanation: 当 so + 形容词置于句首时，主句需部分倒装（助动词提前），表示强调。本课开篇用 So great is our passion...that... 倒装结构，强烈表达「自己动手的热情如此之高，以至于对专业工人的依赖越来越少」。

examples.en: So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves, that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.
examples.cn: 现在我们自己动手做事的热情很高，结果对于专业工人的依赖越来越少了。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases)
points.explanation: 过去分词或现在分词短语可作状语，表示伴随状态、原因或方式。本课用 Armed with... 描述新婚夫妇装备齐全地开始装修，用 Buried somewhere... 描述割草机深埋草丛的状态，使叙述凝练生动。

examples.en: Armed with the right tools and materials, newlyweds gaily embark on the task of decorating their own homes.
examples.cn: 新婚夫妇找来合适的工具和材料，喜气洋洋地开始布置新房。

examples.en: Buried somewhere in deep grass there is a rusting lawn mower which I have promised to repair one day.
examples.cn: 深草丛中的某个地方有一台正在生锈的割草机，那就是我曾答应某日要修理的割草机。

points.title: used to / would 表过去习惯 (Past Habits)
points.explanation: used to + 动词原形表示过去经常或习惯做的事（现已不如此）；would 表示过去愿意或倾向于做某事。本课用 used to entertain 描述姑妈过去常设宴待客的习惯，would not hear of 表示作者过去拒绝听从妻子的建议。

examples.en: Before she grew old, Aunt Harriet used to entertain lavishly.
examples.cn: 哈丽特姑妈年轻时，喜欢大摆宴席，招待宾客。

examples.en: I would not hear of the suggestion and said that I would fix it myself.
examples.cn: 我不愿听妻子的建议，说我自己会修。

exercises.q: So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves, ______ we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.
______ with the right tools and materials, newlyweds gaily embark on the task of decorating their own homes.
Before she grew old, Aunt Harriet ______ to entertain lavishly.
用倒装的 so...that 结构填空：______ great is our passion for doing things for ourselves, that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.（填入修饰 great 的程度副词，置于句首引起倒装）
